scientific_question: Does a single prospectively frozen iZotope RX Music Rebalance Bass export preserve the authorized original-Bass JGA event population and temporal localization materially better than frozen htdemucs_ft?

rx_configuration.workflow: Music Rebalance Render with Bass Solo; Stem Split button not used
rx_configuration.unexpected_control_policy: STOP_WITHOUT_RENDER if any named control/value is unavailable or any additional processing control lacks a neutral/off setting

export.additional_metadata: RX_DEFAULT_ONLY; output SHA-256 governs exact identity

operator_evidence_required_before_analys: RX version/build screenshot or Info panel record
Music Rebalance configuration screenshot showing every control
statement that no preview/listening, tuning, alternate setting, or alternate export occurred

decision_gates.CLEAR_RX_IMPROVEMENT: matched >=672; recall >=0.6367298578199052; F1 >=0.7528071722516166; original-only <=383; precision >=0.933204334365325; and median/RMSE/maximum displacement each <=110% of htdemucs_ft
decision_gates.WORSE_THAN_DEMUCS: any material population worsening: matched <=566, recall <=0.5367298578199052, F1 <=0.7028071722516166, or original-only >=489; OR, absent material population improvement, any timing metric exceeds 125% of htdemucs_ft
decision_gates.NO_MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT: no material population improvement; every population metric remains within its +/- material delta; precision is not below 0.933204334365325; and every timing metric is <=110% of htdemucs_ft
decision_gates.MIXED_RESULT: authority valid and result is neither CLEAR, WORSE, nor NO_MATERIAL; includes population improvement with timing degradation, timing improvement without material population improvement, or conflicting directional metrics
decision_gates.INDETERMINATE: output/protocol authority, unchanged-JGA execution, matching authority, or required replay/verification fails

reproducibility.computational: canonical JGA/report/scoring outputs require exact replay
reproducibility.operator_protocol: single documented manual execution under frozen controls
reproducibility.exact_output_identity: SHA-256 recorded before analysis; no claim that independent RX renders are byte-identical unless separately demonstrated
